speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) how many micro and small enterprises, including sole proprietors, have successfully taken up the SME working capital loan since the implementation of the Support and Stabilisation Package; and (b) how else can the Government help to enhance their cash flow.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The Government has also introduced additional measures to help our businesses.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: MAS, together with banks, finance companies and insurers announced a package of measures last week to help enterprises with their cash flow.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The new COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) Bill being tabled will also provide much needed relief for SMEs which have been impacted by the crisis.
